'''K'lartaeor the Nimble''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He piloted a [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempHutt.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of K'lartaeor the Nimble]]
K'lartaeor the Nimble was cut from [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
